text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Perkhidmatan Bomba (Pegawai Bomba Sukarela dan Pasukan

Bomba Sukarela) 2026.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 3 Februari 2026.

Pelantikan Pegawai Bomba Sukarela

2. Mana-mana orang boleh memohon kepada Ketua Pengarah untuk dilantik

sebagai Pegawai Bomba Sukarela, tertakluk kepada syarat sebagaimana yang berikut:

(a) dia merupakan seorang warganegara Malaysia;

(b) dia sekurang-kurangnya berumur lapan belas tahun pada tarikh

permohonan; dan

(c) dia diperakui sihat oleh pengamal perubatan berdaftar yang berdaftar

di bawah Akta Perubatan 1971 [Akta 50].

Penubuhan Pasukan Bomba Sukarela

3. Seorang Pegawai Bomba Sukarela boleh memohon kepada Pendaftar untuk

menubuhkan suatu Pasukan Bomba Sukarela dalam borang sebagaimana yang

dinyatakan dalam Jadual Pertama, tertakluk kepada syarat sebagaimana yang berikut:

(a) dia mempunyai perlembagaan Pasukan Bomba Sukarela itu;

(b) dia mempunyai surat sokongan daripada Ketua Balai Bomba dan

Penyelamat atau mana-mana Pegawai Kanan Bomba; dan

(c) dia bukan anggota kepada mana-mana Pasukan Bomba Sukarela yang lain.

Perakuan pendaftaran bagi Pasukan Bomba Sukarela

4. Pendaftar hendaklah mengeluarkan suatu perakuan pendaftaran bagi penubuhan

suatu Pasukan Bomba Sukarela dalam borang sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam

Jadual Kedua.

Rayuan Pegawai Bomba Sukarela

5. (1) Jika pelantikan seorang Pegawai Bomba Sukarela ditamatkan oleh

Ketua Pengarah di bawah seksyen 4D Akta, Pegawai Bomba Sukarela itu boleh membuat

rayuan kepada Menteri dalam tempoh dua puluh satu hari selepas dimaklumkan

secara bertulis mengenai penamatan itu.

(2) Suatu rayuan di bawah subperaturan (1) hendaklah dibuat kepada Menteri

dalam borang sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Ketiga.

(3) Apa-apa keputusan yang dibuat oleh Menteri di bawah peraturan ini

adalah muktamad.

FIRE SERVICES ACT 1988

FIRE SERVICES (VOLUNTARY FIRE OFFICER AND VOLUNTARY FIRE BRIGADE)

REGULATIONS 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraphs 62(1)(ca) and (f) read together

with sections 4A, 4B and 4D of the Fire Services Act 1988 [Act 341], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Fire Services

(Voluntary Fire Officer and Voluntary Fire Brigade) Regulations 2026.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 3 February 2026.

Appointment of Voluntary Fire Officer

2. Any person may apply to the Director General to be appointed as

a Voluntary Fire Officer, subject to the conditions as follows:

(a) he is a Malaysian citizen;

(b) he is at least eighteen years of age on the date of application; and

(c) he is certified to be healthy by a registered medical practitioner registered

under the Medical Act 1971 [Act 50].

Establishment of Voluntary Fire Brigade

3. A Voluntary Fire Officer may apply to the Registrar to establish

a Voluntary Fire Brigade in the form as specified in the First Schedule, subject to

the conditions as follows:

(a) he has a constitution of the Voluntary Fire Brigade;

(b) he has a letter of support from the Fire and Rescue Station Chief or

any Senior Fire Officer; and

(c) he is not a member of any other Voluntary Fire Brigade.

Certificate of registration for Voluntary Fire Brigade

4. The Registrar shall issue a certificate of registration for the establishment of

a Voluntary Fire Brigade in the form as specified in the Second Schedule.

Appeal of Voluntary Fire Officer

5. (1) Where an appointment of a Voluntary Fire Officer is terminated by

the Director General under section 4D of the Act, that Voluntary Fire Officer

may appeal to the Minister within twenty one days after being informed in writing

of such termination.

(2) An appeal under subregulation (1) shall be made to the Minister

in the form as specified in the Third Schedule.

(3) Any decision made by the Minister under this regulation shall be final.
